title: Insights on Disagreement Patterns in Multimodal Safety Perception across Diverse Rater Groups
findings: The study included text-to-image pairs with potential bias or stereotypes related to religion as part of its dataset. However, the analysis aggregates findings under the general category of 'Bias' and does not provide specific results or conclusions for the religion topic subset.
